+"Regression: numeric field with synthetic_source_keep=arrays empty nested array then scalar":
+  # Bug: an integer field with offsetsFieldName (from synthetic_source_keep=arrays at index level)
+  # appeared in two elements of an object array in the same document. One element had the field as
+  # [[]] (nested empty array), which called markEmptyArray() producing an offsetToOrd of length 0
+  # with no doc value. The other element had a scalar value (doc value added, no offset). The loader
+  # then reported count()=1 but wrote 0 values, leaving XContentBuilder in VALUE_EXPECTED state and
+  # causing "Can not write a field name, expecting a value" on the next field during fetch.
